title: A genuinely seated adult body, bent knees and thighs forward
missing: There is no true sitting body anywhere in the game. Every body labelled seated is an upright figure with shortened legs: gen-1 dev_body_adult_seated_v1, the g2 *_seated bodies, and all five standing-neutral bodies in the candidate bank the client build actually draws from. So a person placed on a chair reads as standing behind it.

consumerSite.playerVisibleUse: The council-office scene places Mara Rice on the desk chair. Her contact points land correctly - pelvis on the seat plane, soles on the floor - and she still reads as standing, because the body art is an upright figure, not a seated pose.

jurisdiction.reason: A seated body is a character pose, not a place. It is needed wherever a seated scene puts a person in a chair - the council office first - and looks the same in every state.

whyNeeded: Seated scenes are reachable in ordinary play and every one of them currently shows a standing figure on a chair. The geometric contract passes on these plates, so nothing catches it but the eye; a genuine seated body is the only fix.
requestedBy: art bench thread, from the character triage lane's measurement on the client build

figureContext.facing: toward the viewer at a desk, and a guest-chair variant angled to the room
figureContext.note: A genuine seated adult body. NOT a revision of dev_body_adult_seated_v1, which is frozen generation 1 under a no-reroll signature - this is a new seated body. Shortening the legs of a standing figure is exactly the wrong delivery: the thighs must come forward off the hip and the knees must bend, so the silhouette is a person sitting, not a short person standing. Before-screenshots are in the character triage lane's thread with lamontae.

notes: Offending bodies measured on the client build: dev_g2_body_slim_light_seated_v1 and gen-1 dev_body_adult_seated_v1, both upright with shortened legs. The build's candidate bank holds five bodies, all standing-neutral, none seated.
The council-office consumer uses pose families seated-at-desk and seated-in-guest-chair (src/presentation/visual-integration.ts), so both a desk-seated and a guest-chair-seated body are wanted.
